stt-finetune-full.description: Full Whisper Medium QLoRA retrain; resume=auto is enabled in the training config

stt-clean-continuation.description: Continue from the best retrained STT adapter on placeholder-free manifests at LR 2e-5 for 0.5 epoch

stt-test-b-three-way.description: Run fixed clean Test B on baseline, first retrain, and clean-continuation CT2 models, then compare metrics

stt-convert-ct2.description: Merge the best retrained adapter and convert it to CTranslate2 float16

model-envs-bootstrap.description: Create/update model runtime and training environments; may download packages

aihub71592-ict-new-download.description: Download AI Hub 71592 ICT New training source audio; validation source/labels are already verified locally

stt-persona-b1-b2.description: Run B1 new-only then B2 80:20 replay persona STT continuation sequentially

stt-persona-retention.description: Convert B1/B2 persona checkpoints and run B0/B1/B2 historical-retention CT2 evaluation

stt-persona-test.description: Run held-out 1000-utterance new-persona test on B0, B1 cp300, B2 cp200, and B2 cp391

stt-71592-segment.description: Align and segment AI Hub 71592 ICT/New interview answers into <=25s Whisper training clips

stt-71592-c1-c2.description: Train C1 71592-only and C2 71592+20% historical replay continuations from the fixed clean-cont adapter

stt-71592-retention.description: Convert C1/C2 to CT2 and compare B0/C1/C2 on the 4802-utterance historical clean 119 retention validation

stt-71592-final-test.description: Run the selected C2 71592 replay20 model once on the sealed 1233-utterance AI Hub 71592 final test
